name: Pickle Finance ControllerV4 fake-jar swap
summary: ControllerV4.swapExactJarForJar checked only that call targets were approved converters, never that _fromJar/_toJar were Pickle jars. With fake jars the attacker deleveraged the DAI strategy, re-deposited via pDAI.earn, then had the approved CurveProxyLogic make the controller call strategy.withdraw(cDAI) and deposit the cDAI into a fake jar.
notes: Reset: the pDAI jar's controller pointer was switched to ControllerV4 after its deployment, converter approval and DAI strategy registration; the exploit's earn() calls and the strategy's funds ran through that route, so the controller code only governed pDAI from then on.
The strategy's cDAI is unpriced; it is valued at the DAI the attacker redeemed it for. The pDAI jar's idle DAI was re-deposited into the strategy within the transaction and is part of that cDAI.
